translations.web: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
translations.bsb: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
translations.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
translations.asv: and he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
